doc: SPORE's own Android-only sizing table — everything colour/border/shadow/spacing now comes straight from the vendored web/vendor/hardbrut/hardbrut.css (see design/generate.py).
note: The three interactive control sizes (control/chip/row) and the touch-target floor are SPORE's Android product decision, not a HARDBRUT concept — a desktop-first CSS framework has no opinion on touch targets. design/generate.py enforces 'exactly three sizes, each in range' and 'nothing under the touch floor without saying why', then emits Chrome.kt's Metrics object from this table.

controls.role: primary and secondary buttons, and text fields — one height for all three
compact presets and toggles (offline-window, topics). Must still carry a 48dp touch target
list rows — the unit the Bridges/Advanced restructure is built from

touch.role: WCAG/Material floor. control and row clear it by height; chip must be padded out to it.
